Human CFG-OP-CREATE-NOTIFICATION authority cannot produce this receipt.

All identities and digests derive from retained public source, installed/current workload and route owners and actual durable ciphertext custody. No event or caller chooses expected trust, readiness, template, recipient, plaintext, key or occurrence ID; use the original custody-reserved occurrence and object identities.

The complete prepared signing request, immutable original receipt, source inbox admission, operation result, scoped metadata/occurrence/payload references and cursor advance commit atomically. Receipt verification alone proves no SQL effect. Any missing required member rolls back. Retain the original receipt and unresolved outcome across retry/restart; event-ID/data-digest conflict and cursor gaps reject without new effect.

This family commits local occurrence admission only. It neither emits NotificationDeliveryRequested as LS-CONTROL-WORK, sends externally, acknowledges a user, advances a delivery attempt nor proves retention or retirement. Shared signing, current admission, durable owner and real acceptance remain required.
